_readme: First read of Merced College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The registry (probe run 37198225537) records the college's mapper page and its link to merced.programmapper.com, not read. A web search (2026-10-08) found the college's own Program Pathways Mapper page at /getstarted/program-pathway.html, which says each pathway's maps show 'a semester-by-semester path from program entry to completion'. Every Program Mapper host read so far answered 403 (lesson 33), so the mapper gets one load; a refusal is the mapper service's and is not retried another way. The college's own pages are read for any map they publish themselves.

outside_hosts.programmapper.com: The college's own mapper page links merced.programmapper.com as its Program Mapper; one load on the college's behalf, and a refusal is not retried another way.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map: its own pages, a PDF, or only its Program Mapper.
questions.mapper_open: Whether the college's Program Mapper host answers the reader (one load), and how it lists programs and terms if it does.
